scope.purpose: define the evidence, adapter and paired experiment contract required before a semantics-correct calibrated-friction plant can become a fresh training and deployment candidate

physx.runtime_family: Isaac Lab 2.1.0 legacy PhysX articulation joint-friction API
physx.law: available resisting joint force or torque is bounded by a coefficient times an approximation of transmitted spatial force; the solver may hold the axis at rest when the available impulse is sufficient

mujoco.units: generalized_force; N*m for the A3 scalar hinge joints
mujoco.law: load-independent dry-friction constraint that bounds the absolute generalized friction force; joint damping is a separate velocity-linear passive force

mapping_rule.required_method: fit engine-specific adapters to one content-addressed physical latent model and accept them only on the same preregistered generalized-resistance probe grid
mapping_rule.zero_special_case: all-zero friction is the only currently implemented cross-engine friction setting with identical semantics

legacy_frozen_probe.interpretation_limit: preserves evidence that plant transfer matters; it neither validates the legacy coefficients nor estimates a calibrated model

calibration_protocol.joint_population: all 31 A3 actuated hinge joints, with preregistered grouping allowed only after group residual equivalence is demonstrated
calibration_protocol.measurement_target: generalized resisting torque in N*m after subtracting gravity, commanded actuation, inertia and validated viscous terms
calibration_protocol.split_rule: split by complete source session before fitting; no time-adjacent samples from one sweep may cross train and holdout
calibration_protocol.threshold_rule: freeze numeric fit, repeatability and cross-engine tolerances in a content-addressed threshold contract after repeatability characterization and before fitting adapters
calibration_protocol.real_robot_rule: this preregistration authorizes no hardware command; collection requires the existing G07 dry-run, command-scaling, safe-halt and operator approvals, or a separately content-addressed vendor/bench dataset

constraints: static breakaway magnitude is finite and non-negative
dynamic Coulomb magnitude is finite, non-negative and no greater than static breakaway magnitude on the supported grid
viscous coefficient is finite and non-negative
positive and negative directions are fitted explicitly rather than sign-averaged
predictions outside the calibrated load, speed, pose or temperature support are out-of-contract
latent_model_selection.selection_rule: choose the simplest family within the preregistered holdout-error tolerance; freeze its parameters, covariance, support envelope and source split before adapter tuning
latent_model_selection.shared_model_rule: PhysX and MuJoCo adapters must reference the same selected latent-model SHA but may not share engine parameter bytes unless independently fitted values happen to agree

physx.acceptance: measured resisting torque on every preregistered probe cell must satisfy the frozen fit and repeatability tolerances

mujoco.acceptance: measured resisting torque on every preregistered probe cell must satisfy the frozen fit and repeatability tolerances

runtime_binding: A3 asset SHA and actuated joint order
adapter source SHA and instantiated per-joint parameters
probe schedule SHA and complete result SHA
adapter_contract.cross_engine_acceptance: both engines pass their physical-model holdout tolerance and their same-cell generalized-resistance difference passes the frozen cross-engine tolerance; parameter equality is neither required nor sufficient

fixed.training_commit_and_engine: identical within each paired seed block

minimum_training_axis.existing_SZ_reuse_rule: an existing SZ checkpoint is not the matched control if SC needs a different code, asset, solver or non-plant hard-contract field; launch a contemporaneous from-scratch Z control instead
primary_contrasts: C_train_C_eval_minus_Z_train_C_eval within paired seed and engine
Z_train_C_eval_minus_Z_train_Z_eval reproduction or resolution of the 2026-07-07 transfer failure
Isaac_minus_MuJoCo for each identical policy, eval plant, seed, checkpoint and question schedule

claim_labels.training_lineage_exact: fresh checkpoint, motion, bank and instantiated training hard contract are content-addressed; this alone says nothing about physical calibration
claim_labels.evaluation_protocol_exact: immutable paper, denominator, reset and execution protocol are replayed exactly
claim_labels.plant_adapter_replay_exact: a versioned adapter and latent model are replayed byte-for-byte inside their declared support envelope
claim_labels.cross_engine_plant_equivalence_passed: both engine adapters pass the same physical and pairwise probe tolerances
claim_labels.deployment_plant_calibrated: the latent model is fitted to accepted A3 or approved bench evidence with held-out validation
claim_labels.deployment_candidate: all preceding labels plus paired SC-vs-Z training/evaluation evidence and the independent G07 safety gates pass

fail_closed_conditions: status cannot become ready while any required_before_ready binding is missing, null or not a lowercase SHA-256
SP or LP cannot be renamed, reused or scored as the calibrated C plant
a non-zero PhysX coefficient cannot be copied numerically into MuJoCo frictionloss and called exact
current zero-only BankExam exact mode cannot score a non-zero SC adapter as exact without a new versioned evaluator and plant contract
legacy or resumed checkpoints cannot acquire fresh SC lineage
adapter fitting cannot see held-out sessions or BankExam outcomes
q10 cannot stop, promote or choose a plant
Isaac-only or MuJoCo-only success cannot clear cross-engine or deployment claims
out-of-support load, speed, pose or temperature cells cannot be silently extrapolated
missing raw rows, censored attempts, NaN/Inf, contract SHA mismatch or mixed question schedules invalidate the complete cell
